.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/task/solution/app/server.js (seed load line 29, seed insert line 103, post insert line 418)
evidence: Manual application of check-probe-not-in-seed.py; the private checker was not executed. I extracted all 63 distinct JUDGE-* tokens from tests/ (JUDGE-G1, CS0/CS1, W0-W3, WL0/WL1, L1, M1-M3, R0-R3/R1B/RX, X0/X1, TE, H0-H3/H1C, E1, ME1/ME2, F1/F2, P1-P3, U1-U3, D1/D2, O, LA/LB/LE/LG/LR/LV, T0/T1, Q1-Q6, S0-S2, K1-K3). `grep -rnoiE 'JUDGE[-_ ]?[A-Z0-9]*'` over environment/, solution/ and instruction.md returns no matches. I also grepped the seed and the reference markup/code (public/*.html, public/*.js, server.js) for 60 non-token probe phrases and literals the judge creates or searches for as absence or wildcard tests: 'Persist gone', 'Order C', 'Hijack', 'Too late', 'Cross reply', 'Half typed', 'Gate check', 'Version stale', '100%', 'A_1', 'X*9', 'XY9', '1000 pounds', '<img', 'onerror', 'javascript:', 'example.org', 'please review', 'survey update' and the rest. The seed had 0 hits for each. The reference files had a few hits ('Order', 'Escaped', 'Unread', 'Live', '*bold', '`code'), but they are code comments or identifiers (for example app.js:26-27 `inline(escaped)`), not rendered seed content. The only seed hit is 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen.' (seed_data.json:170). timer_changes deliberately edits that seeded message, and its probe JUDGE-TE is absent. The reference's initial state is only the seed: server.js:29 loads seed_data.json and line 103 inserts the seeded messages, with no other hard-coded messages. Searches for seeded content ('Survey booked', 'urvey booked', 'Probate', 'Insurer letter', 'heads of terms', 'Fenwick', 'notice recieved', 'rent review date', 'original lease scan') do not collide with any probe text. The closest is '@dev survey update JUDGE-M2', which does not contain 'survey booked'. The tokens are also substring-safe for their negative searches: 'JUDGE-X0', 'JUDGE-TE', 'JUDGE-O' and 'JUDGE-D1' are not substrings of any other token, and JUDGE-M1 is not a substring of JUDGE-ME1. Weak-app probe: a static or demo app that prefilled any of these values in its markup would be caught only if it were the reference; this reference has none, so no criterion is pre-satisfied by the golden's initial state. A conforming alternative app cannot fail because of pre-satisfaction either, because no probe value exists in the shared seed. Residual note: cross-criterion state, such as Gwen's M-13 unread count of at least 2 or the 'Survey booked' result count, belongs to row 37 and is not seed pre-satisfaction. The '-2' retry suffix in functional/prompt.md:34-35 keeps retry probes distinct.
